_comment: NPC placements worked out from the quest catalogue, for NPCs no capture covers.
Generated by tools/derive_npc_spawns.py. Regenerable; nobody edits this by hand.
THE MAP IS FROM THE CLIENT. THE CELL IS A GUESS - the walkable cell nearest the
middle of the playable area. The cell only exists in the packet that spawns the
actor, so outside a capture nobody has that number. Drag it in the Studio and it
becomes an authored row, which wins over this.
This is the Base layer: a captured placement beats it, an authored one beats both.
NPCs named on more than one map are left out rather than cloned.
why: which quest put the NPC here, so the row can be argued with.
